parameters.query: SELECT e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.position, e.probation_end_date, e.immediate_head, mgr_emp.company_email AS manager_email, e.company_email AS employee_email, (e.probation_end_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_remaining FROM public.employees e LEFT JOIN public.employees mgr_emp ON mgr_emp.user_id = e.immediate_head AND mgr_emp.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.probation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND e.probation_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND e.probation_end_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 day')::date ORDER BY e.probation_end_date ASC;
